tasks.analysis: Chemical engineering is the field of engineering involved in the development, design, and operation of chemical processes. Chemical engineers are also accountable for the management of chemical products. They work in a diversity of industries, including petroleum, food processing, and pharmaceuticals. Chemical engineers must have a solid grasp of chemistry and physics. They apply this expertise to tackle intricate challenges associated with the synthesis of chemicals from raw materials.
